title: Loss of EGFR activity in skeletal stem/progenitor cells is associated with impaired fracture healing in aged mice

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Loss of EGFR activity in skeletal stem/progenitor cells is associated with impaired fracture healing in aged mice》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】To further investigate whether the EGFR signaling can be targeted as a potential therapy for aging-induced fracture delayed union, we designed a two-pronged approach: one involved crossing Prx1-Cre with Egfr flox/flox mice to generate a model with stem/progenitor-specific EGFR inactivation (Egfr iCKO), while the other entailed overexpressing heparin-binding EGF-like growth factor (HBEGF), an EGFR ligand, to generate a stem/progenitor-specific EGFR overactivation model.
